summary.name: ReportLab Plus
summary.one_liner: A commercial PDF generation product from ReportLab that builds PDFs from Report Markup Language (RML) and a preprocessor, built on the open-source ReportLab PDF Toolkit.
use_cases: rendering vector or bitmap charts into PDFs
summary.what_it_does: The page describes ReportLab Plus as a flagship commercial tool for making PDFs using Report Markup Language and a preprocessor, with PDFs created in a way similar to dynamic web pages. Its engine is the open-source ReportLab PDF Toolkit, which lets developers build a graph of Python objects and render them. Related components listed include json2pdf (a scaffold for JSON-in, PDF-out projects), Diagra (Python chart classes rendering as vector or bitmap), PageCatcher (Python access to PDF parsing and reuse code, in ReportLab PLUS), pyRXP (a validating XML parser used for RML, GPL), and Preppy (a templating system bundled with ReportLab PLUS, BSD licence). A PDF accessibility guidelines resource is also mentioned.
notable: Report Markup Language (RML) with a preprocessor for web-page-style PDF templates
Open-source ReportLab PDF Toolkit as the engine, aimed at experienced developers
Bundled Preppy templating and PageCatcher PDF reuse features in the commercial tier
Vector or bitmap chart classes via Diagra
caveats: Flagship product is commercial; some components (PageCatcher, Preppy bundle) are described as part of ReportLab PLUS
The open-source toolkit contains most but not all building blocks
Toolkit is described as suited to experienced developers willing to invest time
